# NuDerma FUSION Wand 4-Piece Set for NuDerma Systems

Expand your NuDerma routine with four fusion wands that combine neon and argon effects in one universal applicator. Compatible with the original NuDerma and NuDerma Professional systems, this add-on set gives you more ways to treat your face, neck, and body.

## Precise Shapes for Hard-to-Reach Areas

The Bent and Tongue wands have slim, targeted tips that reach small crevices and areas around the face. Use them for pinpoint application where broader tools can't easily go.

## Broader Coverage for Larger Surfaces

The Mushroom and Rod wands have wider, flatter heads designed for larger areas of the face and body. Switch between shapes to cover more ground efficiently and tailor each session to the area you're treating.

## Designed for Your Existing System

Each wand is supercharged with a tungsten coil and arrives in a gift box. The NuDerma handle is sold separately, so this set is an ideal accessory for owners who already have a compatible system.

## Add It to Your Skincare Routine

Pair these wands with your regular skincare habits for a fresh, smoother-looking complexion. Results vary, so consistent use is key. Add the NuDerma FUSION Wand 4-Piece Set to your cart today and start building your at-home treatment routine.
